content:
BUILT CoLAB presents here one of its members, Grupo Casais.

Grupo Casais is one of the largest companies in the construction sector in Portugal. It was founded in 1958 and has been expanding its area of activity in recent years. Today, in addition to Engineering and Construction, the Group is present in the Specialties and Industry and Asset Promotion and Management sectors.

Recently named, for the 4th consecutive time, the best construction company in Portugal by the Prémios Construir awards, it has know-how built with skill and rigour in the national and international market. It retains the family character it was originally founded with, which translates into more than 60 years of strategic, ethical and professional principles that have driven its success over time and across various market areas, through rational management and the fulfilment of deadlines and objectives.

Grupo Casais' internationalisation process began in 1994, with its entry into Germany. Built on adapting to local culture and favouring strategic partnerships for a solid presence, Grupo Casais now operates in 17 markets: Portugal, Germany, Angola, Algeria, Belgium, Brazil, United Arab Emirates, Spain, United States of America, France, Ghana, Gibraltar, the Netherlands, Morocco, Mozambique, Qatar and the United Kingdom.

The future involves continued growth in the national market and a focus on internationalisation, consolidating its presence in the countries where it operates and investing in entering other countries.

Grupo Casais' vision is to be a benchmark for knowledge and solidity in the field of Engineering and Construction, working daily with the purpose of building its clients' vision and a better tomorrow.

Its mission is to manage and innovate, favouring strategic partnerships and new markets based on a culture of excellence and sustainability. To this end, the whole company works with simple, clear objectives that set the expected results for each team. Each employee has their own personal mission, the purpose of their work, their contribution to maintaining, sustaining and growing the company.
